definition: Kira Radinsky (Hebrew: קירה רדינסקי; born July 28, 1986) is a Ukrainian-born Israeli computer scientist, inventor and entrepreneur, specializing in predictive data mining. and artificial intelligence, a high-tech manager, scientist, and a visiting professor at the Technion.
details: She is a member of the Israel Securities Authority. Former Director of Data Science and Chief Scientist at eBay Israel. Kira Radinsky (Hebrew: קירה רדינסקי; born July 28, 1986) is a Ukrainian-born Israeli computer scientist and entrepreneur whose work focuses on artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, and predictive data mining. Radinsky is a co-founder and chief technology officer of Diagnostic Robotics and an associate research professor at the Technion – Israel Institute of Technology.

explainer.lead: Kira Radinsky is an Israeli computer scientist and entrepreneur. Her work spans computer science.

contributions.name: She previously co-founded predictive analytics company SalesPredict, which was acquired by eBay in 2016.
Radinsky is also a scientific co-founder of biotechnology company Mana.bio, works with Alma Labs on artificial-intelligence education, and is an independent non-executive director of Nebius Group.

Radinsky's academic research has since evolved from predicting future events from large-scale historical data to developing AI systems that model the dynamics of complex scientific and biological processes.

In 2026, Radinsky co-authored work examining systematic differences in how language models frame geopolitical events and the extent to which such differences can persist even when standard factuality measures indicate neutral responses.
=== SalesPredict and eBay === In 2012, Radinsky co-founded SalesPredict with Yaron Zakai-Or and served as its chief technology officer.

timeline.what: Between 2004 and 2007, Radinsky served in Israeli military intelligence as a programmer.
